summary: Defines MIB objects for managing the Operations, Administration, and Maintenance capabilities of Ethernet-like interfaces, following the OAM clauses of the Ethernet in the First Mile standards. It complements SNMP with link-specific functions. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Network cables need regular checkups. This note gives a standard list of questions an administrator's tool can ask about an Ethernet link's health.
